themes.consensus_view: Most banks see AI spending and compute demand still outrunning supply, fueling earnings and infrastructure capex, but a vocal minority warns the trade is mechanically overextended and valuations are maxed out.

facts_agreed.claim: AI compute and token demand continues to exceed supply, sustaining the case for hyperscaler and infrastructure beneficiaries.
evidence_quotes: demand for AI tokens, the basic unit of AI output, has continued to exceed supply

AI-driven capex is transforming real-world industries, broadening from hyperscalers to physical infrastructure
Independent power producers and US infrastructure development can access the AI supply chain
growth across the four major cloud providers accelerating to an estimated 40% y/y

facts_agreed.claim: The AI buildout is being framed as a multi-year capex supercycle that drives a structural growth cycle for chips, power, and data centers.
evidence_quotes: This is not a traditional cycle and looks more like a one-time CapEx supercycle
industry may be entering one of the largest and longest growth cycles in history
We believe the sector is entering the early stages of one of its biggest

improving fundamentals and structural advantages among hyperscalers reinforce our confidence

AI’s profound impact on infrastructure investment, from data centers to power
